messages:
sarah: uploaded a tiny demo app that shows three resume patterns for the Go Generator SDK: naive reuse ctx, fresh ctx, and an Attach helper. looking for quick API feedback.
dom: link?
sarah: https://git.redwood/internal/sampleapps/gen-resume-patterns - core snippet below: 
```go
// naive (broken if reqCtx expired)
sess := client.Generators.NewSession(reqCtx, opts)
for t := range sess.Stream() { handle(t) }
if sess.Detached() { _, err := client.Generators.Resume(reqCtx, sess.ID) }
```
alan: this is the footgun we've seen in CI. reusing a short-lived request ctx for Resume -> immediate deadline error. we need clearer semantics.
dom: UX choices: a) document "always use a fresh ctx for Resume"; b) make Resume take ResumeOpts{HandshakeTimeout: time.Duration}; c) add Session.Attach(ctx) that performs a bounded internal handshake and returns a resume-able Stream.
sarah: i prototyped Attach that does an internal 5s handshake and returns (Stream, func(ctx) error) so callers don't accidentally reuse expired ctxs. also added an idempotency token hint to avoid duplicate chunks.
alan: also important: server-driven detach is currently surfaced as io.EOF. apps can't tell normal completion from auth-driven detach. propose ErrStreamDetached sentinel + Stream.DetachReason() accessor.
dom: +1. Keep io.EOF for normal end. Put ErrStreamDetached behind an opt-in compat flag for one release.
sarah: tests in the demo: (A) reuse ctx -> expect ErrDeadlineExceeded, (B) fresh ctx -> success, (C) Attach helper -> success and no duplicate messages.
ci-bot: CI: gen-resume-patterns unit tests queued :gear:
auth-bot: incident 2026-03-22T07:00Z: token-service restart caused transient auth window; some generator sessions detached mid-stream.
alan: server-side follow-up: make Resume idempotent server-side (accept cursor + idempotency token, return 409 for incompatible replay) so retries don't emit dupes. SDK can translate 409->ErrDuplicateReplay.
dom: metrics: add gen.resume.path={attach,direct} and gen.resume.handshake_ms to measure how often callers hit expired ctx behavior.
sarah: action items: sarah -> open PR with demo + README called "safe resume patterns", alan -> SDK Attach + ErrStreamDetached behind flag, dom -> metrics + ops ticket, ops -> make Resume idempotent. i'll link PR when ready. thanks! :tada:
